setup.command: set -e; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.0 --activate; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; if ! command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq postgresql; fi

run.command: set -e; if [ "${RUNTIME_PREVIEW_MODE:-production}" = "dev" ]; then exec pnpm dev --port ${PORT:-3000}; fi; pnpm build; exec pnpm start --port ${PORT:-3000}
